guest_languages: Columned LCTL-C 1.0, 'COLUMNED LCTL QVM Profile 1': line 1 must be exactly 'LCTLC/1.0'; '@unit id=<dotted> version=<x.y.z> profile=native [program_version=N ...]'; optional '@defaults ...'; '@frame id=F0000 parent=ROOT module=<dotted>'; 8-column header 'ID│LANE│OP│OUT│CTRL│IN│ARG│META' (U+2502 separators); at least the two alloc rows 'D0001│alloc│Q│q│_│_│1│...' and 'D0002│alloc│C│c│_│_│1│...' (required by the Java canonical verifier: 'no quantum register declared'); VM instructions are rows 'Vnnnn│vm│REG│_│_│_│vm.op=<OP>;dst=Rn;a=Rn;b=Rn;imm=<int|0x..>;width=<bytes>;svc=<id>;target=<label|index>;mode=<modular|checked|saturating|exact>;label=<NAME>│p=quorum:vm5'; optional 'C9999│terminal│.│...' sentinel; '@end'. LCTLC/1.1 and LCTLC/1.2 (BOTTLE ROCKET dialects) are rejected on line 1 by both the QVM parser and the Java verifier.
Canonical LCTL/1.3 (18-cell QTUPLE rows; produced by lowering, verified by the bundled Java jar; not authored directly)
MSSL 0.3 documents (basic_mssl.executable.3) — declarative sealed fact records, not executable code
image_formats: QBRIM 2: canonical JSON {"payload":{magic:'QBRIM',version:2,vm_version,isa_version:1,abi_version:2,word_bits,memory_bytes,stack_depth,program_version,entry:0,instructions:[{op,dst,a,b,imm,width,svc,target,mode,source_row}],source_sha256,capabilities:{memory:[[base,len]],services:[...]}},"signature":{algorithm:'Ed25519',key_id,public_key,signature}}; signature over json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'); files conventionally *.signed.brimg / *.payload.json

NOT accepted: BOTTLE ROCKET BRIM/1 binary images (80-byte 'BRIM' header + 16-byte instructions) — the QVM loader expects UTF-8 JSON and fails with a generic UnicodeDecodeError (exit 70); non-QBRIM JSON -> TRAP_BAD_IMAGE

isa.arithmetic_mode_notes: modular wraps negatives and >1,048,576-bit results; saturating clamps only over-wide results to 2^1048576-1 and TRAPS (TRAP_OVERFLOW 'negative') on negative results; checked/exact trap on both
isa.compare_flag_note: CMP sets -1/0/+1 flag that no branch instruction reads; JZ/JNZ test a register
isa.entry: always instruction index 0 (the @unit entry= field is ignored)
isa.name: QUORUM Generic VM ISA 1

programmatic_drive.compile_cmd: python3 vm/toolchain/quorum_vm.py compile add42.lctlc add42.payload.json --brir add42.brir.json   [--skip-lctl-verify to avoid the JVM]
programmatic_drive.in_process: importlib-load vm/toolchain/quorum_vm.py; c=compile_source(Path(src), VM_ROOT, require_lctl); img=sign_payload(c['payload'], seed32, 'dev-root'); p=verify_image(img, trust_dict, rollback_floor); vm=VM(p, max_steps=N); snap=vm.run(); vm.regs[0]; traps raise VMTrap(name, code, detail); NOTE VM() executes any payload dict — the caller must call verify_image itself
programmatic_drive.result_parse: stdout / --snapshot file is JSON: status ('HALTED'), pc, steps, state_sha256, registers_hex[16], memory_sha256, stack_depth, output_b64, trace_sha256 [, world{...}]; result R0 = int(snapshot['registers_hex'][0],16) (=42 in the probe); console bytes = base64-decode output_b64; traps: non-zero exit = trap code and JSON {status:'TRAP',trap,code,detail} on stderr; other errors exit 70 {status:'ERROR',...}
programmatic_drive.run_cmd: python3 vm/toolchain/quorum_vm.py run add42.signed.brimg --trust vm/keys/TRUST_STORE.json --max-steps 1000000 --snapshot add42.snapshot.json --trace add42.trace.json
programmatic_drive.sign_cmd: python3 vm/toolchain/quorum_vm.py sign add42.payload.json --key vm/keys/DEV_ONLY_private_seed.hex --key-id dev-root --out add42.signed.brimg
programmatic_drive.verify_cmd: python3 vm/toolchain/quorum_vm.py verify add42.signed.brimg --trust vm/keys/TRUST_STORE.json [--rollback-floor N]

runtime_contract: QVM ISA 1 (24 opcodes) / ABI 2: PC + 16 unsigned registers R0..R15 up to 1,048,576 bits + 4,096-byte little-endian guest memory + 256-word stack + compare flag + virtual step clock + LCG PRNG + optional world runtime; per-instruction arithmetic mode modular|checked|saturating|exact; 16 deterministic traps (CLI exit code = trap code); capability-gated memory ranges and services; QBRIM 2 canonical-JSON signed images (Ed25519, key_id trust store, rollback floor); services 0-3 legacy + 16-47 RC-PW world (semantic world ABI 3); default step budget 1,000,000; program <= 65,535 instructions; output <= 4,096 bytes; offline by default (no network device); R0 = primary result register
